name: platformer-fork
title: Platformer (2.1 Fork)
author: xane256 (fork of Platformer by Corlin & Xiroc)
description: Fork of Corlin & Xiroc's Platformer, ported to Factorio 2.1. In a remote corner of the universe, you find yourself adrift on a solitary space platform. With only passing asteroids to sustain you, your progression hinges on your ability to gather resources from these wandering celestial bodies.
